verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own pages explicitly advertise reviewing pull requests on the go, including commenting, approving and merging directly in the app, and Copilot code review from the phone. Hands-on community reports confirm PR review and approval work, though with usability paper cuts such as wrapping diff lines and harder per-commit review. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the review workflow (inline comments, suggested changes, diff navigation), recent hands-on corroboration, smoother diff/per-commit review ergonomics, push notifications for review requests.
